statusLine.command: PROFILE=$(cat $HOME/.claude/.profile 2>/dev/null || echo default); HOST=$(hostname); jq -r --arg profile "$PROFILE" --arg host "$HOST" '"[" + env.HOST_DIR + "] " + $profile + " | " + $host + " | " + .model.display_name + " | " + ((.context_window.used_percentage // 0) | tostring) + "% context"'

hooks.command: prompt=$(jq -r .prompt); if [ "$prompt" = "x" ]; then (sleep 0.1; pkill -INT claude 2>/dev/null) & echo 'Exiting...' >&2; exit 2; fi
